cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(IndagoEmbeddedDependencyFixture LANGUAGES C ASM)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake/StableGeneratedFile.cmake")
if(NOT DEFINED PAYLOAD_TEXT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Explicit PAYLOAD_TEXT required")
endif()
set(payload "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/payload.bin")
set(assembly "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/payload.S")
indago_write_if_different("${payload}" "${PAYLOAD_TEXT}")
indago_write_if_different("${assembly}" ".section .rodata\n.global fixture_payload_begin\n.global fixture_payload_end\nfixture_payload_begin:\n.incbin \"${payload}\"\nfixture_payload_end:\n.section .note.GNU-stack,\"\",@progbits\n")
set_property(SOURCE "${assembly}" APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS "${payload}")
add_executable(embedded_dependency main.c "${assembly}")
